title: The Latest Crier for Feb 06, 2026
items:
Intercollegiate Honor Band

Publicity statement for the Intercollegiate Honor Band 2/6/25 and 2/7/25. 
Hello, All. 

We are excited to announce that Central College is again hosting the Intercollegiate Honor Band Festival on February 6th and 7th. The students will rehearse throughout the day on Friday, February 6th,t and in the morning on February 7th. The Concert will take place in Douwstra Auditorium at 2:00 PM on Saturday, February 7th. The Conductor for the event is Dr. Scott Jones from Ohio State University. The Concert includes works by Adam Schoenberg, Andrew Boysen Jr., Aaron Perrine, and Karl King. Students from the following schools will be participating: Central College, William Penn University, Coe College, University of Dubuque, Buena Vista University, Simpson College, St. Ambrose University, Iowa Central Community College, Northwestern College, and Clarke University. 

The public is invited and encouraged to attend the concert at 2:00 on Saturday. Please consider joining us for a performance of some fantastic wind band music. 

Brad Lampe 

Stan Dahl

St. Mary's Catholic Church FREE shuttle bus to Sunday Mass

The Free shuttle bus to St. Mary's Catholic Church for Mass will run this Sunday 2/8/26. Pick-up will be on the west side of Central Market from 10:10 am to 10:15 am and at Independence and 3rd (4-way stop) from 10:16 am to 10:18 am. 
Pick-up times are carefully followed. Return drop-off will be at Central Market. No reservations are required. 

If you would like a weekly email with confirmation that the shuttle bus services will be provided that Sunday please email fullerj@central.edu.

Central College Mission Statement Central College Mission Statement

Central College Mission Statement Central College Mission Statement Central College is a welcoming learning community committed to vigorous and open inquiry as the best preparation for lives of integrity, creativity, and adaptability. Our students learn collaboratively with supportive educators who share a commitment to intellectual engagement, personal growth, career readiness and civic involvement.Shaped by its Christian heritage, Central College values inclusivity, humility, kindness, and hospitality, and invites learners of all backgrounds and faiths to join us in the pursuit of knowledge, opportunity, and fulfillment.

Social Media Guidelines

The Central College Communications Office wanted to remind everyone of the social media guidelines: 
Contact the Communications Office before creating any account for a department, office, organization or club. 

All affiliated accounts represent Central’s brand. 

Account owners must share usernames and passwords when graduating or stepping away. Provide access to your department supervisor or the Communications Office ( muurm@central.edu ). 

Accounts inactive for six consecutive months may be deleted. 

View our full brand guide: https://brand.central.edu/social-media/
